$comment: Built-in content as bundled packs (ADR-0020). Maps the repo's folders to packs; scripts/build-bundled-packs.mjs writes out/bundled-packs/<id>/ from it and fails on an item mapped to no pack or to two. Docs: docs/packs-format.md#bundled-packs.

packs.name: Action Stations Core
